privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: A short, honest summary of how this demo handles data.
privacy.s1Body: Faroz is a student project shown as a demo. It runs on the team’s own computer and is not a public service.
privacy.s2Body: If you create an account: your name, email, a hashed password, your role and, for centers, the center name. If you learn: your answers, results, progress and group membership. Demo profiles hold only made-up demo data.
privacy.s3Body: You see your own results. Teachers see the groups they teach, answer by answer. Centers see group totals and participation only, never individual scores or answers.
privacy.s4Body: One session cookie keeps you signed in and the interface remembers your language and theme. There are no ads, no analytics and no third-party trackers.
privacy.s5Body: Plans are a concept with demo checkout. No card details are asked for and nothing is charged.
privacy.s6Body: Sign out at any time. To remove your data, ask the project team to delete it.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Plain terms for using this demo.
terms.s1Body: Faroz is built for a university course project and shown as a demo. It is provided as is, without any guarantee that it will be available or error free.
terms.s2Body: Use your own details and keep your password private. Do not enter real personal data you are not comfortable sharing with the project team.
terms.s3Body: Teacher and center plans are concept pricing. Confirming a plan is a demo step: no payment is taken and no invoice is issued.
terms.s4Body: Lessons and quizzes are study aids, not official assessment. Library entries link to third-party sites that have their own terms. Tajik and Russian text is a draft until a native speaker reviews it.
terms.s5Body: Do not try to break, overload or misuse the demo, and do not upload content you do not have the right to share.
